name: EDGE Fellowship

funder.name: Zoological Society of London (EDGE of Existence)

summary: A 28-month fellowship for early-career conservationists leading locally based conservation of EDGE species, with training, mentoring and a £15,000 project grant. Annual cohorts; the 2027 call has closed.

geography.label: Countries outside the G12, EU, New Zealand and South Korea

access.quote: Applicants should first submit an Expression of Interest using the form below.

window.quote: Expression of Interest opens Wednesday 13 May 2026
